observations.content: User supplied nine context-only preparation packets (turns 1–9 of 12) containing an observational-memory implementation plan and repository excerpts as reference for a later explicit implementation prompt; the historical assistant acknowledged each with CONTEXT_RECEIVED.

Historical task requirements: expose actual pi usage cost from observer and consolidator runs to parent orchestrator, including ephemeral and unsuccessful runs when valid usage exists; persist valid costs as session-ledger entries with role/run identity; aggregate costs on all branches including abandoned branches; ignore missing, malformed, non-finite, or negative costs; surface total in status/footer UI; add focused tests for aggregation, invalid entries, handoff, and display.

The observational-memory plan specifies phased short-term observer/ledger/TUI then long-term consolidator/.memory implementation; bespoke recorded headless pi subprocess workers instead of subagents; vendored minimal ledger modules; shared OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator agent extension; orchestrator-assigned unique timestamp IDs; strong Claude Sonnet defaults; and a default-OFF per-session /om gate.

Repository excerpts describe a branch-local observation ledger with timestamp-keyed observations, tombstones, watermarks, /tree rollback, parallel token-bounded observers, and deterministic compaction projection that excludes observations in the verbatim tail; in-flight observer waits have an R5 fast path when safe.

Long-term memory uses project .memory topic files plus orchestrator-generated INDEX.md and consolidator-authored descriptive JOURNEY.md; consolidator handles oldest overflow one run at a time, uses scoped filesystem tools, and tombstones the handed batch intersected with still-active observations after clean exit; files do not roll back under /tree.

The supplied repository excerpts include observer/consolidator prompts and tools, worker launching and IPC, configuration, status/footer gauges, commands and timeline UI, ledger/memory modules, and tests for IDs, folding, progress, projection, compaction cutoff, pool, memory paths, spawning, status, and timeline. They are historical reference material, not implementation requests in this chunk.
